run_perdition.description: Set to "yes" to run perdition; any other value disables it (overrides all other settings).

pop3_enabled.description: Set to "yes" to run POP3 service; any other value disables it.

pop3_flags.description: Additional command-line flags passed to perdition when running in POP3 mode.

pop3s_enabled.description: Set to "yes" to run POP3S (POP3 over SSL/TLS) service; any other value disables it.

pop3s_flags.description: Additional command-line flags passed to perdition when running in POP3S mode.

imap4_enabled.description: Set to "yes" to run IMAP4 service; any other value disables it.

imap4_flags.description: Additional command-line flags passed to perdition when running in IMAP4 mode.

imaps_enabled.description: Set to "yes" to run IMAP4S (IMAP over SSL/TLS) service; any other value disables it.

imaps_flags.description: Additional command-line flags passed to perdition when running in IMAP4S mode.

managesieve_enabled.description: Set to "yes" to run ManageSieve service; any other value disables it.

managesieve_flags.description: Additional command-line flags passed to perdition when running in ManageSieve mode.
